outline.h2: What is a Notice of Intended Marriage (NOIM)?
outline.answers: Primary keyword; PAA 'What is an intent to marry?' (Sydney, Melbourne), 'What do you mean by notice of intended marriage?' (New York); 'noim' AU 1,300; brief must_include 1 and 2
outline.notes: Direct answer in the first 100 words, dated 'as at November 2026', legal basis in the Marriage Act 1961 as AGD states it [[VERIFY: section 42 on legislation.gov.au]]. Exactly 4 one-sentence Key takeaways per the brief. Name 'NOIM' early. Concierge link once (commercial).

outline.h2: When do you need to lodge your NOIM?
outline.answers: 'notice of intended marriage time frame', 'how long before wedding notice of intended marriage'; PAA 'How long does a notice of intent to marry last?'; every Sydney/Melbourne snippet leads with '1 month to 18 months'; brief must_include 3
h3: What happens if you miss the window
outline.notes: SERP snippets say at least 1 month and up to 18 months; one Melbourne result says 'one month and one day'. [[VERIFY: exact window and validity against AGD and the Act]]. Timeline graphic suits this H2.

outline.h2: How to fill out the NOIM form step by step
outline.answers: 'noim form' AU 590, 'notice of intended marriage form' AU 320, related 'how to fill out a notice of intended marriage form'; Paperlust #1 Melbourne owns this angle; brief must_include 4
h3: Step 3: Sign in front of an eligible witness
Step 4: Give it to your authorised celebrant
outline.notes: Numbered H3s. Link the official AGD form only, never a celebrant or stationer copy. No celebrant names. 'Conjugal status' field (Sydney related search) only as phrased on the official form [[VERIFY: current field wording]].

outline.h2: Who can witness a Notice of Intended Marriage?
outline.answers: PAA 'Who can witness a noim?' (New York); Melbourne image pack 'Who can witness a NOIM'; AI Overview lists celebrant, JP, doctor, lawyer, police officer
outline.notes: Only the witness categories AGD lists. AI Overview cites a celebrant saying an Australian celebrant cannot witness when the couple is overseas. [[VERIFY: both witness lists and any remote witnessing rule from AGD]].

outline.answers: AI Overview 'Documents to Provide' (Dubai); Paperlust snippet 'Documents needed'; brief must_include 5
outline.notes: Evidence of birth, identity, any earlier marriage ending, translations, exactly as AGD lists them [[VERIFY]]. Fee: say 'a fee may apply' only as the brief and sources allow; no prices.

outline.h2: Lodging a NOIM when you live overseas
outline.answers: 'notice of intended marriage overseas' (brief); AI Overview reference on overseas witnessing
outline.notes: Destination and expat angle no top-3 result covers. Overseas witness categories [[VERIFY: AGD list]]. Link the apostille article only if documents need authentication.

outline.h2: Can you marry with less than one month's notice?
outline.answers: 'shortening of time marriage' AU 20; BDM Victoria H3 'Lodging your NOIM less than a month before your wedding'
outline.notes: Shortening of time: who decides and on what grounds [[VERIFY: prescribed authority and circumstances from AGD]]. No promises of approval.

outline.h2: Does the NOIM differ by state?
outline.answers: Related searches NSW, Victoria, QLD, WA, PDF (Sydney, Melbourne, New York); related keywords wa 170, qld 140, nsw 110
outline.notes: The NOIM is a Commonwealth form; state BDMs register the marriage afterwards. [[VERIFY: national-form claim]]. Short list of official state registry links only once verified.

outline.h2: NOIM or marrying abroad: which paperwork applies?
outline.answers: Wedded Wonderland gap: no top result links the NOIM to destination weddings; brief Key takeaway 4 (legal at home plus celebration abroad, or legal abroad with a CNI)
outline.notes: A NOIM is for marriages solemnised in Australia; a legal wedding overseas follows that country's rules (CNI, apostille, certificate). Hub for the paperwork links; link rather than restate recognition rules.
